title: Lovely Polish Dough Flatbread
description: A traditional Polish flatbread featuring fermented dough, chopped parsley, and a cozy atmosphere, perfect for a snack or light meal, and is whole30-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
